fields.title: Board round improvement ideas, Medicine (example)

sample.caseTitle: Can we trust our Flow Manual audit, and where should we focus?
sample.look: Quick wins: the challenger role, live EDD updates, a fixed 9am start and Discharge Unit referrals. Consultant of the Week is high impact but hard, so plan it as a bigger project.
